title: Generated Text (Textable, Record)
description: Generated text structured as a map with metadata.
documentation:
## Purpose
Carries the complete text generation result from an LLM cap, including the generated text and any associated metadata such as token counts, finish reason, and timing. This is the non-streaming counterpart to [LLM Text Stream](https://capdag.com/browse/media:llm-text-stream;ndjson).

## When to use
Use this type when a cap returns the full generated output in one shot rather than streaming tokens. Callers that do not need incremental delivery should prefer this simpler interface over the streaming variant.

## Notes
The outer object is a flat map; implementations should include at minimum a `text` or `generated_text` key containing the model output. Additional metadata keys such as `tokens_generated`, `finish_reason`, and `generation_time_ms` are recommended for observability.

## Textable
Coercion marker indicating the value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text.
Strings are textable trivially; integers and booleans are textable via their
string form; structured values are textable when JSON-serialised. Binary blobs
(images, audio, raw bytes) are NOT textable — converting them to text requires
explicit transformation that may be lossy.

The value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text without loss.

## Record marker
Presence marker indicating the value's content is a key-value mapping at its
root: a JSON object, a CSV row with named columns, a TOML table, an INI file.
Independent of `list-marker` — a value can be both (a list of records),
either alone, or neither.

The value's content is a key-value mapping. Consumers can expect to address
fields by name.
